title: Energy, Work and Power Module 3 Lesson 1: Power Driving Force Speed custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A car travels along a straight level road at a constant speed of $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The resistance to motion is $800\text{ N}$. Calculate, in $\text{kW}$, the power developed by the car's engine.
The engine of a car develops a constant power of $36\text{ kW}$. Find the driving force exerted by the engine at an instant when the car is travelling at a speed of $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

A car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ is moving along a straight level road. The car's engine works at a rate of $45\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion is $750\text{ N}$. Find the acceleration of the car at the instant when its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

A van of mass $1600\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight horizontal road. The engine operates at a maximum power of $56\text{ kW}$ against a constant resistance to motion of $1400\text{ N}$. Find the maximum speed of the van.

A car of mass $1000\text{ kg}$ travels at a constant speed up a straight road inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.05$. The resistance to motion is $600\text{ N}$. The engine works at a rate of $44\text{ kW}$. Calculate the constant speed of the car. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A truck of mass $8000\text{ kg}$ descends a hill inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.04$, at a constant speed of $18\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The resistance to motion is $4200\text{ N}$. Find, in $\text{kW}$, the power delivered by the engine. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1250\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight level road. The engine works at a constant rate of $48\text{ kW}$ and there is a constant resistance to motion of $960\text{ N}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the driving force and acceleration of the car at the instant when its speed is $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the maximum constant speed that the car can maintain on this level road.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1100\text{ kg}$ is moving at a constant speed of $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ up a straight road inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.08$. The engine of the car works at a rate of $35.2\text{ kW}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the driving force exerted by the engine.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the resistance to motion opposing the car.

questions.prompt: A lorry of mass $9000\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight level road at a steady speed of $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$ with its engine working at $72\text{ kW}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the constant resistance to the lorry's motion.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The lorry now travels up a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.05$. The resistance to motion remains unchanged. The engine power is increased to $90\text{ kW}$. Find the acceleration of the lorry at an instant when its speed is $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and determine the maximum steady speed the lorry can achieve up this hill.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1400\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $600\text{ kg}$ along a straight horizontal road. The car and trailer are connected by a light rigid horizontal towbar. The resistance to motion is $400\text{ N}$ on the car and $200\text{ N}$ on the trailer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: The car and trailer move at a constant speed of $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Calculate the power developed by the car's engine in $\text{kW}$, and find the tension in the towbar.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The engine power is increased to $36\text{ kW}$ while resistances remain constant. Find the acceleration of the system and the tension in the towbar at the instant when the speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ descends a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.04$, at a constant speed of $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The engine works at a rate of $15\text{ kW}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the constant resistance to the motion of the car.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The car reaches the bottom of the hill and continues on a straight level road with the same resistance $1080\text{ N}$. If the engine power is increased to $45\text{ kW}$, find the acceleration of the car at the instant its speed is $25\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and calculate the maximum speed the car can achieve on the level road.

questions.prompt: A sports car of mass $1500\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight level road. The resistance to motion is modelled as $R = kv^2\,\text{N}$, where $v\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ is the speed and $k$ is a constant. When the engine operates at a power of $64\text{ kW}$, the car maintains a constant maximum speed of $40\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that $k = 1$, and calculate the acceleration of the car when its engine is working at $64\text{ kW}$ and its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The car now ascends a hill inclined at angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.05$. The engine works at its maximum power of $90\text{ kW}$. Write down an equation for the steady speed $V$ up the hill, and by testing values or algebraic rearrangement, find the steady speed $V$ to 3 significant figures. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

questions.prompt: A tractor of mass $3200\text{ kg}$ is pulling a heavy trailer of mass $1800\text{ kg}$ up a slope inclined at $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.06$. The tractor and trailer are connected by a light rigid towbar parallel to the line of greatest slope. The resistance to motion is $700\text{ N}$ on the tractor and $500\text{ N}$ on the trailer. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Given that the maximum steady speed of the tractor and trailer up the slope is $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find the maximum power developed by the tractor's engine in $\text{kW}$, and calculate the tension in the towbar at this steady speed.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: At an instant when the speed of the tractor is $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$, the engine is working at its maximum power of $63\text{ kW}$. Calculate the acceleration of the tractor and trailer, and find the tension in the towbar at this instant.
